title: Capturing cash non-additivity and horizon risk via BSDEs and generalized shortfall
abstract: arXiv:2603.14024v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Whenever dealing with horizons of different times scales, risk evaluation of losses may incur in both interest rate uncertainty and horizon risk as introduced in [11]. With the goal to capture both effects, we work with cash subadditive fully-dynamic risk measures. In this work we consider such measures obtained via the BSDE and the shortfall approaches. We stress that we consider BSDEs both with Lipschitz and quadratic drivers. We then introduce the hq-entropic risk measure on losses as an effective example of fully-dynamic risk measure serving the scope. Shortfall risk measures are extended to capture cash non-additivity. For our newly introduced h-generalized shortfall risk measures we provide a dual representation and we connect them to fully-dynamic certainty equivalent. To conclude, we can see that the hq-entropic risk measures on losses belong to the family h-generalized shortfall, but they are not of certainty equivalent type

translated_title: 通过BSDE与广义缺口度量捕捉现金非可加性与期限风险
translated_abstract: 在处理不同时间尺度的期限时，对损失的风险评估可能同时涉及利率不确定性以及文献[11]中引入的期限风险。为了同时捕捉这两种效应，我们采用现金次可加的全动态风险度量。在本工作中，我们考虑通过BSDE（倒向随机微分方程）方法和缺口方法获得的此类风险度量。我们强调，所考虑的BSDE既包括具有Lipschitz驱动项的情形，也包括具有二次驱动项的情形。随后，我们引入了损失上的hq-熵风险度量，作为实现该目标的有效全动态风险度量实例。我们将缺口风险度量进行扩展，以捕捉现金非可加性。对于新引入的h-广义缺口风险度量，我们给出了对偶表示，并将其与全动态确定性等价物建立联系。最后，我们证明了损失上的hq-熵风险度量属于h-广义缺口家族，但并不属于确定性等价类型。
tldr: 本文通过带Lipschitz和二次驱动项的BSDE以及新引入的h-广义缺口风险度量来捕捉现金非可加性与期限风险，给出了该度量的对偶表示并与全动态确定性等价物建立联系，同时证明损失上的hq-熵风险度量属于h-广义缺口家族但非确定性等价类型。
en_tdlr: This paper captures cash non-additivity and horizon risk via BSDEs with Lipschitz and quadratic drivers and newly introduced h-generalized shortfall risk measures, provides their dual representation and connection to fully-dynamic certainty equivalents, and shows that the hq-entropic risk measure on losses belongs to the h-generalized shortfall family but is not of certainty equivalent type.
